title: 把森林，带回城市

referenceImage.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: a single consistent perfume-bottle reference photograph for a 16-second cinematic film titled 把森林，带回城市. Create one photorealistic landscape 16:9 image, preferably 2048x1152, not a collage. One 50 ml cylindrical amber-glass perfume bottle with straight vertical sides, a thick flat glass base, amber liquid and a polished circular silver cylindrical cap, no printed label or engraving. It stands upright on wet black slate on a rainy city rooftop at night. Front three-quarter view at bottle height; the entire bottle and cap are clearly visible, centered, occupying about 48 percent of image height. Cool deep-blue city bokeh in the distance; restrained warm amber rim light from upper right. Subtle clear reflections of cedar branches and vertical tree trunks appear only inside the glass; no actual trees on the rooftop. Fine water droplets on glass, slight plausible haze. Refined restrained luxury advertising photography, realistic glass thickness, rigid symmetrical bottle, quiet mysterious mood. No text, no logos, no extra objects. The product shape and lighting must be clear enough to serve as a reference for top-down cap macro and camera arc shots.
referenceImage.requestedResolution: 2048x1152 preferred, not guaranteed by built-in generation

shots.title: 城市的一滴雨
shots.prompt: 5 seconds, 16:9. Locked top-down macro view of wet black slate on a rainy rooftop. A small circular puddle is centered, about 44 percent of frame height in diameter. One raindrop lands at its center and creates one clearly expanding ring. Cool blue city lights reflect in the water with a faint amber reflection along one edge. Keep the camera, focal length and stone texture stable, with coherent liquid motion. The perfume bottle is outside the frame. No lettering. Quiet gentle rain ambience only, no speech and no music. A single continuous shot without cuts.
shots.designPromptZh: 3 秒，16:9。雨夜屋顶上湿黑色石板的垂直俯拍微距。一个圆形小水洼位于画面中心，直径约占画面高度的 44%。一滴雨落在圆心，只形成一圈清楚扩散的水纹。冷蓝城市灯光倒映在水面，一侧有微弱琥珀色反光。摄影机与焦距完全固定，石板纹理稳定，保持真实液体运动。香水瓶尚不进入画面，画面没有文字。
shots.editNote: 记录水纹的圆心与直径；在水纹轮廓清楚的一帧切出，供镜头 2 对齐。

shots.title: 一个圆，连接两种世界
shots.prompt: 5 seconds, 16:9. Locked top-down macro view of the polished circular silver cap on the same 50 ml cylindrical amber-glass perfume bottle. Center the cap at 44 percent of frame height in diameter to match the preceding water ring. From the first frame, its surface contains a clear, stable reflection of cedar branches with only a slight leaf movement. Retain wet black slate, cool blue reflections and restrained amber accents. Keep the camera fixed and the cap contour rigid. No lettering. Quiet gentle rain ambience only, no speech and no music. A single continuous shot without cuts.

shots.title: 绕过瓶身，发现森林
shots.prompt: 5 seconds, 16:9. The same unlabeled 50 ml cylindrical amber-glass perfume bottle with its polished circular silver cap stands on wet black slate on a rainy rooftop. Cool blue city bokeh sits in the distance; restrained amber rim light defines the glass. Arc the camera left by 90 degrees at a constant radius, always facing the bottle, with stable framing and focal length. Rain trails remain on the glass while reflected cedar trunks shift naturally with the viewpoint. The bottle stays still and rigid; the city environment remains continuous. Quiet gentle rain ambience only, no speech and no music. A single continuous shot without cuts.
shots.designPromptZh: 5 秒，16:9。同一只无文字标签的 50ml 圆柱形琥珀玻璃香水瓶，抛光银色圆形瓶盖，直立在雨夜屋顶的湿黑色石板上。冷蓝城市散景位于远处，暖琥珀色轮廓光勾出玻璃边缘。摄影机以恒定半径向左环绕 90 度，始终朝向瓶身，保持产品大小和焦距稳定。真实雨痕留在玻璃上，雪松树干的倒影随视角自然滑动。产品不旋转、不变形，城市环境保持连续。
shots.editNote: 以统一产品参考图控制瓶型、瓶盖和色泽；不要同时要求产品自转或额外变焦。

shots.title: 给安静留一个位置
shots.prompt: 5 seconds, 16:9. Keep approximately 55 percent of the right side as clean deep-blue negative space for later typography. Distant city lights are softly defocused. One off-screen streetlamp from the upper right illuminates slowly drifting light haze with a narrow, plausible warm beam. Lock the camera and bottle, keep the product sharp and unobscured, and generate no text or logos. Quiet gentle rain ambience only, no speech and no music. A single continuous shot without cuts.
